email.title: Email address
email.description: Where we send sign-in links, receipts and security notices.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs out every other device.
password.setDescription: Your account signs in with {providers}. Add a password to sign in with your email address too, and to turn on two-factor authentication.
password.updated: Your password was changed, and every other device was signed out.
password.added: Your password was set, and every other device was signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: After your password, signing in also asks for a code from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.needsPassword: Set a password first: two-factor authentication protects signing in with your email address and password.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy.
twoFactor.qrCode: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this setup key instead
twoFactor.setupError: We couldn't start the setup. Please try again.
twoFactor.regenerated: Your new backup codes are ready, and the old ones no longer work.
twoFactor.backupCodesDescription: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. We show them only now, so keep them somewhere safe, such as your password manager.

descriptions.enable: Confirm your password, then add {appName} to your authenticator app.
descriptions.disable: Signing in will ask only for your password. Your backup codes stop working.
descriptions.regenerate: Your current backup codes stop working as soon as the new ones are created.
descriptions.verify: Add {appName} to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.

twoFactor.copyFailed: We couldn't copy the codes. Select them and copy them yourself.

accounts.title: Connected accounts
accounts.description: Sign in with these accounts as well as with your email address.
accounts.lastMethod: This is the only way you sign in. Set a password or connect another account before you disconnect it.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: The browsers and devices that are signed in to your account.
sessions.othersRevoked: Every other device is signed out.
sessions.noOthers: No other device is signed in.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently delete your account and the data stored with it.
delete.consequences: Deleting your account signs you out everywhere and removes your profile, your sign-in methods, your two-factor settings and your course progress.
delete.dialogDescription: We'll email you a link to confirm. Nothing is deleted until you open it and confirm.
delete.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. It works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
